channel.title: A Better Nerd is Possible: Art, Design, Health and Democracy
channel.itunes:author: Alice Jaggers and Avery Barrett
channel.description: Come hang out in our clubhouse! Alice and Avery have started a SUPER SECRET book club. Every month, we meet with a mission: explore art, design, health and democracy to find ways nerds can make the world a better place.

item.title: Dark Larp
item.description:
Question your fears. Expand your world. And look below if you want to discover our SECRET BOOKS this month!

Want to join the club? Read a book! Then email us (coded message or not) at betternerdpod@proton.me

You can find us on Instagram and Mastodon. If you would like to support more interesting things coming from your favorite possible nerds, you can support us now on Patreon.

Bookshop affiliate links earn us a commission on your purchase.

SECRET BOOKS

:

Nightfaring: In Search of the Disappearing Darkness, by Megan Eaves-Egenes

Nordic Larp, ed. Jaako Stenros, Markus Montola

Also mentioned

If You Want to Win, You've Got to Fight: A Guide to Effective Transportation Advocacy, by Carter Lavin

item.title: Representation and Repurposing
item.description:
Examine your biases. Find your power.

In this episode, Avery and Alice begin their journey to make better nerds who can make the world a better place. They discuss recognizing the power to make a difference that often goes unnoticed or unrealized.

Making Nonfiction Comics: A Guide for Graphic Narrative, by Eleri Harris and Shay Mirk

Strike: Labor, Unions and Resistance in the Roman Empire, by Sarah E. Bond

Also mentioned:

Sex from Scratch: Making Your Own Relationship Rules, by Shay Mirk

To learn more about gladiators and Roman history, check out this episode of the podcast Half-Arsed History, by Riley Knight.

Want to join the club? Read a book! Then email us (coded message or not) at betternerdpod@proton.me

You can find us on Instagram and Mastodon. There's nothing posted either place yet, but you can follow us and maybe something interesting will happen. If you would like to support more interesting things coming from your favorite possible nerds, you can support us now on Patreon.
